title: Wrong datetime for BG from Xdrip + false "Missing BG" alarm
body:
AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1, build 479bfc410

Repeatable error, occurs aprox. 2-3 times / month. 
Confirmed by other users

Scenario:
- Correct BG reading with correct time is received and saved in Xdrip
- In AAPS this BG is recorder with wrong time (4-8 h back).
- That raises "missing BG" alert
- With the next reading (normally 5 minutes later) the same BG is added with correct date, but the one backdated also remains 

Logs avaliable per request, sample screenshots attached
